name: Thread Builder
subtitle: Turn an idea or rough notes into a thread ready to schedule.
summary: Takes your raw material (a sentence, bullet notes, or a pasted draft) and builds a thread with a strong hook, tight parts, and a closer, then puts it on an approval card to edit and schedule.
provide: the idea or notes; optionally target length.
get: a full thread draft (up to 25 parts) ready to edit and schedule.
launchPrompt: Turn this idea into a thread with a strong hook and put it on a card I can edit and schedule: [your idea]
